rationale: All deterministic checks pass. Strict invariant YYYY-MM-DD parsing is shared by add and due, invalid dates are rejected before storage changes, undated legacy tasks remain compatible, and reports correctly filter, sort by date then numeric ID, include completed tasks only on request, and derive overdue solely from the supplied cutoff. JSON is banner-free and text output labels overdue and cutoff items clearly. The date helper is focused and reusable, while the report pipeline is readable and preserves stable types and order. Help and tests cover invalid dates, legacy data, filtering, ordering, labels, banner constraints, and output modes. The banner is immediately recognizable as a due-date report, with strong framing, centered hierarchy, balanced whitespace, and a meaningful dates/action motif. The diff is precise and contains no unrelated changes.
